standards_note: Local reader-outcome and plain-language implementation. This is not an ISO 24495 conformity, certification, or compliance claim.

writer_authority: plain-language explanation inside the evidence boundary
writer_forbidden_authority: broader populations, settings, timeframes, or comparators
authority_model.rv_rule_status: R### processing rules and V### register rules remain induction evidence. Until stable, they may inform drafting but cannot override TA06 truth, the reader contract, or this runtime gate.

live_ta06_lane.fallback: If the handoff is missing, blocked, internally inconsistent, or superseded by new source material, return to TA06. EvidenceProse does not silently repair scientific truth.

induction_lane.purpose: observation, rule induction, contamination detection, held-out reconstruction

semantic_preservation.precision_precedence: When readability and scientific precision conflict, scientific precision wins.

reader_outcome_audit.execution: Audit the completed draft. These axes are not four mandatory full-document rewrite passes.
reader_outcome_audit.usable_boundary: Usability may clarify already-supported implications or actions. Missing actor, deadline, destination, threshold, prescription, or next step is recorded in missing_action_info and must not be invented.

local_thresholds.de_chain: three de modifiers within a 24-character punctuation-bounded clause
local_thresholds.hedge_stack: two or more non-overlapping terms from the validator hedge lexicon in one sentence

article_length_policy.counted_scope: reader artifact ## 內容 section only
article_length_policy.semantic_precedence: The ceiling must not erase material claims, limitations, applicability boundaries, uncertainty, evidence roles, or causal limits.

repair_policy.hard_failure: Target the smallest sentence or paragraph that repairs the failed semantic invariant.
repair_policy.global_rewrite: Not required unless the user explicitly requests it or local repair cannot restore a coherent article.
repair_policy.warning_lint: May be left unresolved when repair would reduce precision or distort register.

release_gate.pass_rule: All hard semantic checks must pass, no reader-outcome axis may be fail, all repairs must be verified, and no recorded violation may have severity hard.

delivery.sidecar_article_binding: article_sha256 over exact delivered UTF-8 bytes
